Former TMC MLA Asish Banerjee Found Dead; Suicide Note Mentions Political Pressure

Former Trinamool Congress MLA Asish Banerjee was found dead at his party office in West Bengal. A suicide note reportedly found at the scene stated, "Politics was a mistake," and mentioned pressure. The note also indicated an inability to protest against party wrongdoings. The death has triggered a political blame game, with opposition leaders alleging blackmail and threats from "corrupt elements" within the TMC. The Chief Minister has ordered a probe into the circumstances surrounding the death, citing potential political pressure.
